notes: The tolerance is relative because the candidate stores elevations as Float32. It was derived from that representation and not fitted to the result; the protocol states the derivation.
GRASS reproduces all eight closed-form volumes to within 1e-6 m3, so the residual is the candidate's alone and is bounded at 7e-6 relative.
Truth is scored first. Two programs summing the same wrong cells would agree perfectly, so agreement between implementations is reported second.

The freeze is adopted-with-result rather than a preregistration: the protocol landed in the same commit as the first result, and the witness commit carries the fixture matrix, the level of detection and the tolerance basis.

reference.containerPinningNote: A container digest is the pin this record wants. GRASS was installed from conda-forge into a host environment rather than pulled as an image, so no digest exists to record; the resolved executable path, the version GRASS reports and the exact command line stand in for it.
reference.commandLine: r.mapcalc "d = eb - ea" ; r.mapcalc gain/loss with the same LoD rule ; r.univar -g

datasets.description: Eight synthetic two-epoch grid pairs at one metre: uniform lift, block uplift, block excavation, near-cancelling cut and fill, sub-threshold, just above threshold, holes in one epoch, and a per-cell ramp. Each carries the gain and loss volume computed from its construction.

parameterSets.description: One-metre square cells, a single global level of detection of 0.05 m, strict inequality on both sides, and a cell absent from either epoch treated as not comparable.

metrics.toleranceUnit: relative to the compared volume, with a 1e-9 m3 absolute floor

statusReason: All eight pairs agree with GRASS r.univar on gain and loss volume and on the gained and lost cell counts, and with the closed-form volume each pair was built from. The largest relative difference is 7e-6, inside the registered 1e-5. Nothing was widened.

unsupported: Per-cell LoD95. One global level of detection is applied and cells are treated independently.
Real epoch pairs. The evidence is synthetic and cross-implementation, not field validation.
Registration error, which propagates into every cell and is absent by construction here.
Non-metre CRS units and non-square cells. Only one-metre metre-CRS grids were measured.
Agreement with GRASS is not accuracy against a surveyed volume.
